package imports
import (
 "testing"
 "github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/ast"
)
func TestWave15SpecifierControls(t *testing.T) {
 f := ast.NewNodeFactory(ast.NodeFactoryHooks{})
 SpecifierNode(nil)
 SpecifierNode(f.NewIdentifier("other"))
 SpecifierNode(f.NewImportDeclaration(nil,nil,nil,nil))
 SpecifierNode(f.NewImportDeclaration(nil,nil,f.NewIdentifier("computed"),nil))
 for _, nodes := range [][]*ast.Node{nil, {}, {nil}, {f.NewIdentifier("first")}, {f.NewIdentifier("first"),f.NewIdentifier("second")}} {
  SpecifierNode(f.NewCallExpression(f.NewIdentifier("notImport"),nil,nil,f.NewNodeList(nodes),0))
 }
 SpecifierNode(f.NewCallExpression(f.NewIdentifier("empty"),nil,nil,nil,0))
 call := f.NewCallExpression(f.NewIdentifier("alias"),nil,nil,f.NewNodeList([]*ast.Node{nil}),0)
 call.AsCallExpression().Arguments.Nodes[0] = call
 if SpecifierNode(call) != call { t.Fatal("call alias lost") }
 declaration := f.NewImportDeclaration(nil,nil,nil,nil)
 declaration.AsImportDeclaration().ModuleSpecifier = declaration
 if SpecifierNode(declaration) != declaration { t.Fatal("import alias lost") }
}
